name: A burned wrist
prompt: {name} catches {their} wrist on the fryer basket. The rail is full.

outcome.told: {name} runs it under the tap and comes back with {their} wrist wrapped. Two of {their} plates go out late.
You run both sides of the grill for ten minutes. Nothing comes back.

failure.told: You fall behind on both. {name} is back before you've caught up.
